contexts.label: Close product details
contexts.detail: Familiar system action in a compact modal header
contexts.decision_evidence: The conventional X keeps the strongest silhouette at 16 px and matches learned close behavior. The custom ring adds visual mass and falsely suggests a status badge, so custom work is rejected.

context_evidence.viewport: Goodturn product dialog at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844 plus 16, 20, and 24 px comparison targets

candidates.name: Lucide X
candidates.source: Lucide X SVG at pinned upstream revision
candidates.license: Lucide ISC / Feather-derived icons MIT; see LUCIDE_LICENSE.txt
candidates.rationale: Direct learned symbol, open silhouette, and family-ready 24-grid construction.

candidates.name: Orbit close challenger
candidates.source: repository-owned custom challenger drawn for rejection proof
candidates.rationale: REJECT: the enclosing circle crowds the diagonals at 16 px and implies a badge or bounded status without adding meaning.

candidates.name: Visible Close text
candidates.rationale: Clear but consumes unnecessary header width for a universally learned close action in this context.

contexts.label: Personal fit
contexts.detail: Thirty measured minutes for frame, saddle, reach, and the clothes you actually ride in.
contexts.decision_evidence: At Goodturn's implemented 32 px size, the custom ruler-plus-frame mark connects measurement to bicycle setup and fits the neighboring service family better than the generic ruler. The 16 and 20 px rows expose its small-size risk; the visible label remains the semantic owner.

context_evidence.viewport: 1440 × 900 host render plus 16, 20, 24, 28, and 32 px comparison targets

candidates.name: Lucide Ruler
candidates.source: Lucide Ruler SVG at pinned upstream revision
candidates.rationale: Recognizable measurement symbol, but it does not distinguish fit setup from generic sizing or workshop measurement.

candidates.name: Goodturn fit frame
candidates.source: repository-owned custom drawing for Goodturn Cycles benchmark
candidates.rationale: SELECTED at the implemented 32 px host size: ruler ticks and the minimum frame triangle connect measurement to bicycle setup without secondary decoration.

candidates.name: Label only
candidates.source: No asset; visible service label and explanation
candidates.rationale: Semantically sufficient, but the selected small custom family materially reinforces Goodturn's measurement/service identity here.

contexts.label: Check and continue
contexts.detail: High-stakes action before any eligibility outcome exists
contexts.decision_evidence: Visible action text is complete. A badge-check icon visually implies verified eligibility before the service has checked evidence, so no icon is the more truthful and accessible outcome.

context_evidence.viewport: 390 × 844 and 1440 × 900 host renders plus 16, 20, and 24 px comparison targets

candidates.name: Lucide Badge Check
candidates.source: Lucide Badge Check SVG at pinned upstream revision
candidates.rationale: REJECT: the verified badge describes a successful outcome, not the action that begins an eligibility check.

candidates.name: Action text only
candidates.rationale: SELECTED: exact verb and object communicate the action without asserting a result or adding scanning noise.
